clauses.reason: Paragraph 5 supersedes EO 9419 of 1944 (effective with this order) and preserves existing regulations under that order so far as consistent, until modified or revoked by regulations prescribed under this order by the Secretary concerned. The held current-law note extract prints paragraph 5 unchanged as part of the order. The words until modified or revoked make the preservation of any particular old regulation contingent, but no held source shows the modification or revocation of every such regulation, so no end is claimed for the paragraph; the paragraph is not an end of the order, whose commands in paragraphs 1-4 continue.

research_rationale:
EO 11046 (27 FR 8575, signed 1962-08-24; held official Federal Register text, page location high) authorizes the Secretaries of the military departments (and the Coast Guard's Secretary) to award the Bronze Star Medal (paragraph 1 with subparagraphs (a)-(c)), sets design and regulations (2), limits to one medal with devices (3), allows posthumous award (4), and supersedes EO 9419 while keeping existing regulations until replaced (5). It rests on the President's authority as President and Commander in Chief, not on a statute, so no authority statute can have lapsed. The held original has no sunset, expiry, condition subsequent or revocation. Later instruments found by name or by number in the held texts: EO 11382 section 13 (1967-11-28; Treasury to Transportation in paragraph 1), EO 13286 section 70 (68 FR 10619; effective 2003-03-01; Transportation to Homeland Security in section 1) and EO 14085 section 4 (87 FR 60541, signed 2022-10-03; paragraph 1 wording, Space Force). All three amend paragraph 1 only and none revokes or supersedes the order. The held current-law extract of the Code (release point 119-121; only the extracted note text is held, so it is corroboration and not a claim source) prints the order in full as a note to 10 U.S.C. 7276, as amended by those three orders, with no ending statement. The ofr_catalog search reports three hits for this order, which are exactly these three amendments. Cutoff limit: the held Code edition is current through 2026-10-09; laws enacted 2026-10-10 to 2026-10-14 are not reflected.
Member checks: {"earlier_end_check":"No earlier end is held. The order has no own-terms end: the word until appears only in paragraph 5, where it limits how long the pre-1962 regulations are preserved, not how long the order's commands run. A search of the held texts for the number 11046 finds EO 11382, EO 13286, EO 14085 and the held current-law note extract (all amendments or printings), plus the 1989 OFR codification line treating the order as in force. The packet's chain also labels one amendment as EO 12977, but the held text under that label (a source-ladder file named for EO 12977) is EO 13286 section 70; the official text of EO 12977 (Interagency Security Committee) does not mention EO 11046, so EO 12977 is not recorded as an event.","independent_command_check":"Paragraph 1 (award authority and eligible persons), 2 (design and regulations), 3 (one medal, devices), 4 (posthumous award) and 5 (supersession of EO 9419 and preservation of existing regulations) are separate commands. Subparagraphs (a)-(c) are the three eligibility situations of paragraph 1. Each is decided on its own; none is exhausted by performance because each governs awards that continue to be made.","savings_check":"See savings reason. The supersession sentence of paragraph 5 took effect with the order and is retained in the held current-law note extract; the preservation sentence is recorded as continuing because no held source shows that every regulation prescribed under EO 9419 has been modified or revoked, and an end needs evidence.","scope_check":"EO 11382 and EO 13286 change only the officer named in paragraph 1 (and in 11382 the same words wherever they appear in the listed orders). Paragraphs 2-5 have no held amendment; the held current-law note extract prints them unchanged. Under the strike-and-insert ruling of 2026-10-21 each amendment is a later event on the clause it changes and the clause continues."}

savings.reason: The order has not ended, so no residual outlasting an end arises. Its only savings text is the second sentence of paragraph 5 (existing regulations under EO 9419 remain in effect until modified or revoked by regulations prescribed under this order), decided separately as clause EO:11046#c-5. None of the three bounded searches names an instrument that revokes, replaces or ends that sentence.
